population.value: Persons aged 60-77 years at an increased dementia risk (dementia Risk Score 6 points or more and at least one CERAD criterion met), without dementia or substantial cognitive decline
population.quote: aims to prevent cognitive impairment, dementia and disability in 60-77 year old persons at an increased dementia risk
population.location: Brief summary; detail in Eligibility, Inclusion/Exclusion Criteria

followup.value: 2-year intervention period, with an extended follow-up planned until at least 300 participants have developed dementia; all registered outcome time frames are 2 years
followup.quote: We hypothesize that the multi-domain intervention will reduce cognitive impairment in the study group compared to the control group during the initial 2-year intervention period

intervention.value: Multi-domain lifestyle counseling: nutritional guidance, increased physical activity, cognitive training, increased social activity and intensive monitoring of vascular and metabolic risk factors
intervention.quote: Multi-domain lifestyle counseling including nutritional guidance, increased physical activity, cognitive training, increased social activity and intensive monitoring of vascular and metabolic risk factors.

comparator.value: Standard health counseling at baseline, registered as a NO_INTERVENTION arm
comparator.quote:
- **Standard health counseling at baseline** (NO_INTERVENTION): no description
- **Lifestyle counseling** (EXPERIMENTAL): Multi-domain lifestyle counseling including nutritional guidance, increased physical activity, cognitive training, increased social activity and intensive monitoring of vascular and metabolic risk factors.

risk_of_bias.judgement: The record registers masking as SINGLE for a multi-domain behavioural lifestyle intervention against a no-intervention control arm, so participants and intervention staff were not blinded to allocation.
The comparator is registered as a NO_INTERVENTION arm receiving standard health counseling at baseline, with no description given, so contact time differs substantially between arms.
risk_of_bias.quote: - **Standard health counseling at baseline** (NO_INTERVENTION): no description

risk_of_bias.judgement: As observed on 2026-08-13 the overall status was UNKNOWN and the enrollment figure was ESTIMATED rather than actual, so the registered enrollment may not reflect the number actually randomized.
